name: Ory Keto Example Dev Container
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ory/meta/master/install.sh | bash -s -- -b ~/.local/bin ory && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && echo "export PATH=\"$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH\"" >> ~/.zshrc && chmod +x .devcontainer/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null || true && cd keto-test && npm install && echo "alias restart-keto=\"bash /workspace/.devcontainer/scripts/restart-keto.sh\"" >> ~/.zshrc && echo "alias ory-keto-check=\"bash /workspace/.devcontainer/scripts/ory-keto-check.sh\"" >> ~/.zshrc && echo "alias keto=\"docker compose -f /workspace/docker/docker-compose.yml exec keto keto\"" >> ~/.zshrc && docker compose -f /workspace/docker/docker-compose.yml up --watch'
